rubric_items.reason: All nine ACs map to REQ-1..REQ-15. The AC6 search and status-filter parts are overridden by cited answers, and the overrides are stated.
Compound ACs are split (AC6, AC8, AC9). REQ-13 'rest of the dashboard is unchanged' is broad but can still be checked by regression.
Every known REQ cites a ticket line, a context fact or an answer. REQ-9 is now decided by this run's answered Q-01 (prior F-1 resolved).
Both AC6 clashes (status filter, search) are recorded with the answer and the ticket line, each with a stated mismatch. REQ-7 is now qualified by REQ-9 (prior F-2 resolved).
No needless questions. The search question was answered after being routed to the tech lead, not to the product owner as in the ended run. The artifact does not note this.
Plain and consistent wording. The missing glossary terms Registered and Contact details are named with reasons.

findings.text: REQ-9 overrides ticket AC6 using an answer to a question that was routed to the tech lead. The ended run had routed the same UX question to the product owner. The artifact records who answered but not this change of role.
